name: 侠客行2017
english_description: The Story of Hero, MudOS v21 lineage — part of the same core codebase family as this project's xkx100 and xkx2000zxb, visible at a glance in the structure of combatd.lpc and quest.h. It shares that core codebase but with a noticeably more compact map: the major sects (Huashan, Wudang, Shaolin, the Beggars' Sect, Emei, the Ming Cult, and more) are all present, but it lacks xkx100's frontier settings like the northern steppes, Kazakhstan, or Taiwan, reading more like a streamlined remake. Unlike its sibling xkx2000zxb, admin privileges here use the standard wizlist text-file mechanism with no site-IP lock, making it simpler to set up.
